limitations: Only Chromium 153.0.8010.12 was executed successfully; final official Firefox download attempt timed out and local launch was unavailable. Edge is Chromium and is not a second engine.
Native browser zoom and screen readers were not exercised. CSS enlargement/spacing and native keyboard activation are explicitly scoped tests.

Axe retained two color-contrast incomplete cases for horizontally scrollable code at 320/390; computed token contrast and native keyboard scrolling were reviewed separately, without excluding axe rules or claiming all incomplete checks automatically resolved.

The 679-check main harness uses focus+Enter on outward detail/runbook links and clicks for returns. The separate 15-route supplement exercises native Tab+Enter for the complete website routes without focus() or mouse clicks. Browser Back itself uses the browser history API.

Control clipping/overlap checks cover visible core routes and ignore collapsed details content; they do not prove all arbitrary content or assistive technology behavior. The current ID input has no placeholder; supplementary sizing uses actual typed value 123.
The published portable supplement/pair helpers remove private local module/cache paths; their public hashes differ from the preserved original executed tool hashes.
